question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Abundant
solution: The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'Minimal.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option: Word Meaning Abundant existing in large quantities, more than enough or plentiful. (प्रचुर) Minimal smallest possible amount or the least possible. (कम से कम) • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options: Word Meaning Aplenty sufficient quantities, plentiful. (पर्याप्त रूप से) Plentiful existing in large amounts or numbers; abundant. (प्रचुर) Fertile (of soil or land) producing or capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops. (उपजाऊ) • Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Abundant' and 'Minimal' are antonyms. • So, the correct answer is option 1. 3d:T17b4,
